title: Pic Match
description: A picture-matching game you can play with friends in a shared room.
detail: Real-time multiplayer rooms with support for reconnecting after a dropped connection.

title: Secret Hitman
description: A party game with private word boards, shared clues, and a host who leads each round.
detail: The server controls hidden card roles, scoring, and host-only actions.

title: Online Scavenger Hunt
description: Solve a series of online puzzles, with hints if you get stuck.
detail: Progress is saved locally so players can leave and return to the hunt.

title: Work Timer
description: Track work and break sessions at your own pace.
detail: Review session history and accumulated work and break time.
